name: Mass Dispel
description: Dispels magic in a 15 yard radius, removing all harmful Magic from 5 friendly targets and 1 beneficial Magic effect from 5 enemy targets. Potent enough to remove Magic that is normally undispellable.

name: Power Infusion
description: Infuses the target with power for 15 sec, increasing haste by 20%.\n\nCan only be cast on players.

name: Desperate Prayer
description: Increases maximum health by 25% for 10 sec, and instantly heals you for that amount.

name: Evangelism
description: Immediately Power Word: Radiance your target at 150% effectiveness, and causes your next 2 casts of Power Word: Radiance to be instant cast with 40% reduced mana cost.

name: Psychic Scream
description: Lets out a psychic scream, causing all enemies within 8 yards to flee, disorienting them for 8 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect.

name: Fade
description: Fade out, removing all your threat and reducing enemies' detection range against you for 10 sec.

name: Void Torrent
description:
Channel a torrent of void energy into the target, dealing 3,930 Shadow damage over 3 sec and tearing open an Entropic Rift.

 Entropic Rift
Mind Blast tears open an Entropic Rift that follows the enemy for 8 sec. Enemies caught in its path suffer 228 Shadow damage every 0.9 sec while within its reach.

Generates 24 Insanity over the duration.

name: Pain Suppression
description: Reduces all damage taken by a friendly target by 40% for 8 sec. Castable while stunned.

name: Leap of Faith
description: Pulls the spirit of a party or raid member, instantly moving them directly in front of you.

name: Angelic Feather
description: Places a feather at the target location, granting the first ally to walk through it 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec. Only 3 feathers can be placed at one time.

name: Dispel Magic
description: Dispels Magic on the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.

name: Holy Nova
description: An explosion of holy light around you deals up to 156 Holy damage to enemies and up to 117 healing to allies within 12 yds, reduced if there are more than 5 targets.

name: Mind Blast
description: Blast the target's mind for 301 Shadow damage. Costs a high amount of mana.

name: Power Word: Radiance
description: A burst of light heals the target and 4 injured allies within 40 yards for 2,153, and applies Atonement for 60% of its normal duration.

name: Shackle Horror
description: Shackles an aberration or undead enemy for 50 sec, preventing all actions and movement. Damage will cancel the effect. Limit 1.

name: Shadow Word: Death
description: A word of dark binding that inflicts 328 Shadow damage to your target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 5% of your maximum health.\n\nDamage increased by 150% to targets below 20% health.

name: Shadowfiend
description:
Shadow Word: Death has a 40% chance to summon a Shadowfiend for 5 sec when damaging targets below 20% health.

 Shadowfiend
Summons a Shadowfiend to attack your target for 5 sec.

Generates 0.5% mana each time the Shadowfiend attacks.

name: Ultimate Penitence
description: Ascend into the air and unleash a massive barrage of Penance bolts, causing 17,351 Holy damage to enemies or 40,757 healing to allies over 5.4 sec.\n\nWhile ascended, gain a shield for 100% of your health. In addition, you are unaffected by knockbacks or crowd control effects.

name: Power Word: Barrier
description: Summons a holy barrier to protect all allies at the target location for 10 sec, reducing all damage taken by 20% and preventing damage from delaying spellcasting.

name: Dominate Mind
description: Controls a mind up to 1 level above yours for 30 sec while still controlling your own mind. Does not work versus Demonic, Mechanical, or Undead beings or players. This spell shares diminishing returns with other disorienting effects.

name: Mind Control
description: Controls a mind up to 1 level above yours for 30 sec. Does not work versus Demonic, Undead, or Mechanical beings. Shares diminishing returns with other disorienting effects.

name: Spirit of Redemption
description: The Priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 6 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the Priest can cast any healing spell free of cost.

name: Ascension
description: Ascend into the air, keeping you out of harm's way. Lasts 20 sec. Can only be used while in Ashran.

name: Light's Wrath
description: Draws upon the power of Light's Wrath, dealing 665 Radiant damage to the target, increased by 10% per ally affected by your Atonement.

name: Purify
description: Dispels harmful effects on the target, removing all Magic effects.

name: Purify Disease
description: Removes all Disease effects from a friendly target.

name: Power Word: Shield
description: Shields an ally for 15 sec, absorbing 1,747 damage.

name: Mind Soothe
description: Soothes enemies in the target area, reducing the range at which they will detect you by 10 yards. Only affects Humanoid and Dragonkin targets. Does not cause threat. Lasts 20 sec.

name: Penance
description: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 913 Holy damage to an enemy or 4,053 healing to an ally over 1.8 sec. Castable while moving.\n\nWhen you heal with Penance, everyone with your Atonement is healed for 71.

name: Echo of Light
description: Heals every 2 sec for 4 sec.

name: Flash Heal
description: A fast spell that heals an ally for 2,573.

name: Levitate
description: Levitates a party or raid member for 10 min, floating a few feet above the ground, granting slow fall, and allowing travel over water.

name: Light of T'uure
description: Applies Light of the Naaru to the target, healing for 380 and increasing your healing done to that target by 25% for 10 sec.

name: Mass Resurrection
description: Brings all dead party members back to life with 35% health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Mind Vision
description: Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min. Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.

name: Plea
description: A quick, efficient plea to heal an ally for 1,140.

name: Power Word: Fortitude
description: Infuses the target with vitality, increasing their Stamina by 5% for 1 hour.\n\nIf the target is in your party or raid, all party and raid members will be affected.

name: Resurrection
description: Brings a dead ally back to life with 35% health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Shadow Word: Pain
description: A word of darkness that causes 64 Shadow damage instantly, and an additional 424 Shadow damage over 16 sec.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Smite
description: Smites an enemy for 372 Holy damage.

name: Mindgames
description: Assault an enemy's mind, dealing 1,139 Shadow damage and briefly reversing their perception of reality.\n\nFor 7 sec, the next 3,990 damage they deal will heal their target, and the next 3,990 healing they deal will damage their target.

name: Inner Light
description:
Inner Light: Healing spells cost 10% less mana.

Inner Shadow: Spell damage and Atonement healing increased by 10%.

Activate to swap from one effect to the other, incurring a 6 sec cooldown.

name: Absolute Faith
description: Leap of Faith also pulls the spirit of the 3 furthest allies within 40 yards and shields you and the affected allies for 2,851.

name: Dark Archangel
description: Casting Evangelism increases your damage, and the damage of all allies with your Atonement by 10% for 12 sec.

name: Improved Mass Dispel
description: Reduces the cooldown of Mass Dispel by 60 sec.

name: Phase Shift
description: Step into the shadows when you cast Fade, avoiding all attacks and spells for 1 sec.\n\nInterrupt effects are not affected by Phase Shift.

name: Psychic Shroud
description: When your Psychic Scream affects 1 or more players, the next crowd control effect against you is prevented. Lasts 6 sec.

name: Purification
description: Purify now has a maximum of 2 charges.\n\nRemoving harmful effects with Purify grants your target an absorption shield equal to 5% of their maximum health. Lasts 8 sec.

name: Strength of Soul
description: Your Power Word: Shield reduces all Physical damage taken by 15% while the shield persists.

name: Trinity
description: Atonement duration increased by 10 sec.\n\nSmite, Penance, Mind Blast, and Void Blast have 10% reduced cast time when you have Atonement on 3 or more allies.

name: Ultimate Radiance
description: Evangelism cooldown is reduced by 45 sec and Power Word: Radiance healing is increased by 15%.

name: Abyssal Reverie
description: Atonement heals for 10% more when activated by Shadow spells.

name: Angel's Mercy
description: Reduces the cooldown of Desperate Prayer by 20 sec.

name: Angelic Bulwark
description: When an attack brings you below 30% health, you gain an absorption shield equal to 25% of your maximum health for 20 sec. Cannot occur more than once every 90 sec.

name: Archangel
description: Evangelism increases your healing and absorption effects by 15% for 18 sec.

name: Assured Safety
description:
Casting Prayer of Mending applies Power Word: Shield to your target.

 Power Word: Shield
Shields an ally for 15 sec, absorbing 1,784 damage.

name: Atonement
description: Power Word: Shield, Flash Heal, Plea, Penance, and Power Word: Radiance apply Atonement to your target for 15 sec.\n\nYour spell damage heals all targets affected by Atonement for 30% of the damage done. Healing is reduced when healing more than 5 targets.

name: Benevolence
description: Increases the healing of your spells by 3%.

name: Binding Heals
description: 20% of Flash Heal healing on other targets also heals you.

name: Blaze of Light
description: The damage of Smite and Penance is increased by 8%, and Penance increases or decreases your target's movement speed by 25% for 2 sec.

name: Body and Soul
description: Power Word: Shield and Leap of Faith increase your target's movement speed by 40% for 3 sec.

name: Borrowed Time
description: Casting Power Word: Shield increases your Haste by 5% for 4 sec.

name: Bright Pupil
description: Reduces the cooldown of Power Word: Radiance by 3 sec.

name: Castigation
description: Penance fires one additional bolt of holy light over its duration.

name: Collapsing Void
description: Each time Penance damages or heals, Entropic Rift is empowered, increasing its damage and size by 10%.\n\nAfter Entropic Rift ends it collapses, dealing 1,672 Shadow damage split amongst enemy targets within 15 yds.

name: Dark Energy
description: While Entropic Rift is active, you move 20% faster.

name: Dark Enlightenment
description: Increases your haste by 3%.

name: Dark Indulgence
description: Mind Blast has a 100% chance to grant Power of the Dark Side and deals 20% additional damage.

name: Darkening Horizon
description: Void Blast increases the duration of Entropic Rift by 1.0 sec, up to a maximum of 3 sec.

name: Death's Torment
description: Shadow Word: Death deals damage 2 additional times at 15% effectiveness.

name: Desperate Measures
description: Desperate Prayer lasts an additional 10 sec.\n\nAngelic Bulwark's absorption effect is increased by 15% of your maximum health.

name: Devour Matter
description: Shadow Word: Death consumes absorb shields from your target, dealing 971 extra damage to them and granting you 1% mana if a shield was present.

name: Divine Aegis
description: Direct critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 30% of the amount healed. Lasts 15 sec.

name: Divine Feathers
description: Your Angelic Feathers increase movement speed by an additional 10%.\n\nWhen an ally walks through your Angelic Feather, you are also granted 100% of its effect.

name: Divine Procession
description: Smite extends the duration of an active Atonement by 2.0 sec.

name: Embrace the Shadow
description: You absorb 3% of all magic damage taken. Absorbing Shadow damage heals you for 100% of the amount absorbed.

name: Encroaching Shadows
description: Shadow Word: Pain Spreads to a nearby enemy when you cast Penance on the target.

name: Enduring Luminescence
description: Reduces the cast time of Power Word: Radiance by 30% and causes it to apply Atonement at an additional 10% of its normal duration.

name: Entropic Rift
description: Mind Blast tears open an Entropic Rift that follows the enemy for 8 sec. Enemies caught in its path suffer 223 Shadow damage every 0.9 sec while within its reach.

name: Eternal Barrier
description: Power Word: Shield absorbs 20% additional damage and lasts 5 sec longer.

name: Everlasting Light
description: Surge of Light occurs up to 50% more often based on your missing mana.

name: Expiation
description: Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death consume 1 sec of Shadow Word: Pain, dealing damage equal to 300% of the amount consumed.

name: False Autonomy
description: Increases the duration of Mind Control and Dominate Mind against enemy creatures by 15 sec.

name: Focused Power
description: Increases the damage of your spells by 3%.

name: Foreseen Circumstances
description: Guardian Spirit lasts an additional 2 sec.

name: Greater Smite
description: Casting Smite increases the damage of Smite by 15%, stacking 2 times. Lasts 2 sec.

name: Guiding Light
description: Prayer of Mending gains an additional charge.

name: Harsh Discipline
description: Power Word: Radiance causes your next Penance to fire 3 additional bolts, stacking up to 2 charges.

name: Holy Ray
description: Each successive Penance bolt during a channel deals 5% increased damage and healing.

name: Improved Fade
description: Reduces the cooldown of Fade by 5 sec.

name: Improved Flash Heal
description: Increases healing done by Flash Heal by 15%.

name: Improved Purify
description: Purify additionally removes all Disease effects.

name: Indemnity
description: Atonements granted by Power Word: Shield last an additional 4 sec.

name: Inescapable Torment
description: Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death cause your Shadowfiend, Mindbender, and Voidwraith to teleport behind your target, slashing up to 5 nearby enemies for 319 Shadow damage and extending their durations by 0.7 sec.

name: Inner Focus
description: Flash Heal, Power Word: Shield, Penance, and Power Word: Radiance have a 20% increased chance to critically heal.

name: Inner Quietus
description: Power Word: Shield absorbs 20% additional damage.

name: Inspiration
description: Reduces your target's physical damage taken by 5% for 15 sec after a critical heal with Flash Heal or Penance.

name: Lenience
description: Atonement reduces damage taken by 2%.

name: Light's Inspiration
description: Increases the maximum health gained from Desperate Prayer by 10%.

name: Light's Promise
description: Power Word: Radiance gains an additional charge.

name: Lightburst
description: Increases the damage of Holy Nova by 400%, its healing by 500%, and its cooldown by 30 sec.

name: Master the Darkness
description:
Penance has a high chance to upgrade Power Word: Shield into Void Shield.

 Void Shield:
Shields 3 allies for 15 sec, absorbing 2,607 damage.

name: Mental Agility
description: Reduces the mana cost of Purify and Mass Dispel by 50% and Dispel Magic by 10%.

name: Mindbender
description: Evangelism summons a Mindbender to attack a nearby target for 12 sec.\n\nGenerates 0.2% Mana each time the Mindbender attacks.

name: Mindpierce
description: Increases the damage of Smite by 15%.

name: Move with Grace
description: Reduces the cooldown of Leap of Faith by 30 sec.

name: No Escape
description: Entropic Rift slows enemies by up to 70%, increased the closer they are to its center.

name: Occultist
description: Shadow damage and healing done increased by 15%.

name: Overwhelming Shadows
description: Mind Blast deals 100% increased damage.

name: Pain Transformation
description: Pain Suppression also heals your target for 15% of their maximum health and applies Atonement.

name: Pain and Suffering
description: Increases the damage of Shadow Word: Pain by 8% and increases its duration by 2 sec.

name: Painful Invocation
description: Increases the damage of Shadow Word: Pain by 10%.

name: Painful Punishment
description: Each Penance bolt extends the duration of Shadow Word: Pain on enemies hit by 1.5 sec.

name: Petrifying Scream
description: Psychic Scream causes enemies to tremble in place instead of fleeing in fear.

name: Phantasm
description: Activating Fade removes all snare effects.

name: Phantom Reach
description: Increases the range of most spells by 15%.

name: Piety
description: 20% of overhealing done is redistributed to up to 4 nearby injured allies.

name: Power of the Dark Side
description: Shadow Word: Pain has a chance to empower your next Penance with Shadow, increasing its effectiveness by 30%.

name: Preemptive Care
description: Increases the duration of your Renew by 40%.

name: Preventive Measures
description: Increases the healing done by Prayer of Mending by 15%.\n\nAll damage dealt by Smite, Holy Fire and Holy Nova increased by 40%.

name: Prompt Prognosis
description: Casting Prayer of Mending heals your target for 3,572.

name: Prophet's Insight
description: Atonement healing from Holy spells is increased by 15%.

name: Prophet's Will
description: Your Flash Heal and Holy Word: Serenity are 30% more effective when cast on yourself.

name: Protective Light
description: Casting Flash Heal on yourself reduces all damage you take by 10% for 10 sec.

name: Protector of the Frail
description: Pain Suppression gains an additional charge.\n\nPower Word: Shield reduces the cooldown of Pain Suppression by 3 sec.

name: Psychic Voice
description: Reduces the cooldown of Psychic Scream by 10 sec.

name: Purge the Wicked
description: Holy damage increased by 10%.

name: Quickened Pulse
description: Shadow Word: Pain and Entropic Rift deal damage 25% more often.

name: Revel in Darkness
description: Shadow Word: Pain deals 5% additional damage and spreads to 1 additional target when you cast Penance to its target.

name: Sanctuary
description: Smite prevents the next 684 damage dealt by the enemy.

name: Sanguine Teachings
description: Increases your Leech by 2%.

name: Save the Day
description: For 6 sec after casting Leap of Faith you may cast it a second time for free, ignoring its cooldown.

name: Searing Light
description: Your Penance bolts sear the enemy, dealing 20% of its damage over 8 sec.

name: Shadow Mend
description:
Shadow Word: Pain damage has a chance to upgrade your next Flash Heal to Shadow Mend. Stacks up to 2 charges.

 Shadow Mend:
Wraps an ally in shadows which heal for 6,831, but at a price.

The ally will take 337 damage every 1 sec, until they have taken 3,384 total damage from all sources, or leave combat.

name: Shadow Tap
description: Mind Blast deals 150% increased damage, but costs 40% more mana.

name: Sheer Terror
description: Increases the amount of damage required to break your Psychic Scream by 25%.

name: Shield Discipline
description: When your Power Word: Shield is completely absorbed, you restore 0.5% of your maximum mana.

name: Spectral Illusion
description: Fade creates an illusion of you for 4 sec, tricking enemies to attack it instead.

name: Spell Warding
description: Reduces all magic damage taken by 3%.

name: Spiritual Guidance
description: Increases your Intellect by 3%.

name: Strength of Resolve
description: Increases your Stamina by 6%.

name: Surge of Light
description: Your healing spells and Smite have a 8% chance to make your next Flash Heal instant and cost 50% less mana. Stacks to 2.

name: Tithe Evasion
description: Shadow Word: Death deals 50% less damage to you.

name: Touch of the Void
description: Voidheart now persists for 8 sec after Entropic Rift ends.

name: Translucent Image
description: Fade reduces damage you take by 10%.

name: Twin Disciplines
description: Increases the damage and healing of your Holy and Shadow spells by 2%.

name: Twins of the Sun Priestess
description: Power Infusion also grants you its effect at 100% value when used on an ally. \n\nIf no ally is targeted, it will grant its effect at 100% value to a nearby ally, preferring damage dealers.

name: Twinsight
description: 3 additional Penance bolts are fired at an enemy within 40 yards when healing an ally with Penance, or fired at an ally within 40 yards when damaging an enemy with Penance.

name: Twist of Fate
description: After damaging or healing a target below 35% health, gain 5% increased damage and healing for 8 sec.

name: Unfolding Vision
description: When Power Word: Shield or Void Shield expires with absorption remaining, it jumps to a nearby injured ally and loses 40% of its maximum absorb instead.

name: Unwavering Will
description: While above 75% health, the cast time of your Flash Heal, Prayer of Healing, and Smite are reduced by 5%.

name: Void Blast
description:
Entropic Rift upgrades Smite into Void Blast while it is active.

Void Blast:
Sends a blast of cosmic void energy at the enemy, causing 567 Shadow damage.

name: Void Empowerment
description: Summoning an Entropic Rift extends the duration of your 5 shortest Atonements by 1 sec.

name: Void Infusion
description: While Entropic Rift is active, Atonement healing with Void Blast and Penance is 50% more effective.

name: Void Leech
description: Every 3 sec siphon an amount equal to 4% of your health from an ally within 40 yds if they are higher health than you.

name: Void Tendrils
description: Call shadowy tendrils to constrict enemies when Psychic Scream ends, rooting them in place for 4 sec.

name: Voidheart
description: While Entropic Rift is active, your Atonement healing is increased by 20%.

name: Voidwraith
description:
When Entropic Rift ends, a Voidwraith is summoned from the collapsed rift for 5 sec.

Voidwraith
Summon a Voidwraith that casts Void Flay from afar. Void Flay deals bonus damage to high health enemies, up to a maximum of 50% if they are full health.

Generates 0.5% Mana each time the Voidwraith attacks.

name: Waste No Time
description: Reduces the cooldown of Prayer of Mending by 1.5 sec.

name: Weal and Woe
description: Your Penance bolts increase the absorb of your next Power Word: Shield by 3%.\n\nStacks up to 10 times.

name: Words of the Wise
description: Flash Heal, Plea, and Power Word: Radiance healing increased by 15%.
